evidence_limits: Original material comes from the pinned repository. New files only extract or capture existing content and record verification; no experiments or checker execution were performed.
Saved results on synthetic PDE instances; within-dialect 100 percent does not imply cross-dialect generalization or physical solving ability.
Cross-dialect CSVs are percentages rounded to one decimal in notebook code; preserve these source values.
Trash score is correctly classified examples failing a simple keyword check divided by all test examples; it is not a comprehensive reasoning-validity audit.
dialect_results.json contains within-dialect scores with n1000 each; it is a separate experiment from the cross-dialect matrix.
Klein-Gordon is held out; keyword_rate is lexical matching and top_family is a predicted training family, not a successful discovery of an unseen family.
README preliminary approximate ROUGE figures differ from exact saved dialect_results.json values. Use the exact artifact for an interactive chart and identify the experiment.
The team README assigns cross-dialect evaluation and benchmarking to Yit Xiaang Ztang; credit the team for shared results.
